Position Summary:

Trulioo is seeking a commercially minded and execution-oriented Senior Director, Global Privacy & Data Protection to lead our global privacy strategy, data protection program, and designated Data Protection Officer.

Reporting to the Chief Risk and Strategy Officer, this role will actively lead how privacy, data protection, AI governance, and responsible data use are embedded across Trulioo’s products, operations, commercial motions, and governed by leading practices. This is a senior leadership role for a privacy executive who can operate in scaling, agile environments and partnering with Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Enterprise Risk, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

The ideal candidate brings extensive expertise in GDPR, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws, with experience in emerging areas including, but not limited to, biometrics, AI, age verification, data retention, data classification, and emerging identity technologies.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position working on a hybrid model from one of our offices or fully remote.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Global Privacy Strategy & DPO

  • Build and lead Trulioo’s global privacy and data protection strategy across priority markets, products, customers, and operating environments.

  • Serve as Trulioo’s designated Data Protection Officer for Europe, providing independent, credible, and commercially practical advice on GDPR and related obligations.

  • Advise executive leadership, as needed, on privacy risk, regulatory change, customer expectations, and strategic trade-offs tied to product innovation and market expansion.

  • Represent Trulioo in privacy-related engagements with regulators, enterprise customers, industry groups, and other external stakeholders.

  • Act as a strategic advisor on privacy and data protection implications as Trulioo expands into new operating regions, verticals, and expands the product catalog.

  • Monitor global privacy developments and translate implications into practical guidance for products, operations, market expansion, and customer commitments.

Privacy Program Operations & Governance

  • Mature Trulioo’s privacy program, including PIAs, DPIAs, records of processing, data subject rights, vendor privacy reviews, and cross-border transfer mechanisms. Integrate privacy by design into product development, commercial contracting, customer onboarding, third-party management, enterprise risk management, and agile operating rhythms.

  • Own and evolve key privacy and data governance policies, including data retention, data classification, information classification and protection, data handling, and responsible data use.

  • Lead privacy incident readiness and response, including investigation support, breach assessment, regulatory notification analysis, remediation, and post-incident improvement.

  • Develop practical reporting, metrics, and executive-level insights that create visibility into privacy risks, regulatory readiness, and program maturity.

Commercial Enablement, Product, & Engineering Advisor

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design into agile product development, architecture decisions, data flows, and release processes.

  • Provide guidance on privacy risks tied to identity verification, fraud prevention, biometrics, document verification, data enrichment, AI, machine learning, and emerging identity technologies.

  • Serve as a senior privacy advisor to Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Solutions, and Legal in support of enterprise due diligence, RFPs, audits, and strategic customer engagements.

  • Help shape responsible AI governance, including privacy impact analysis, consumer data use, automated processing, transparency, and controls for responsible product deployment.

  • Lead or support negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, data transfer terms, privacy schedules, customer commitments, vendor terms, and partner arrangements.

  • Support commercialization by validating privacy positioning, customer-facing claims, contractual commitments, and market- specific privacy requirements.

  • Build privacy thought leadership that strengthens Trulioo’s credibility with customers, regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing privacy team with strong judgment, business orientation, and operational discipline.

  • Create clear decision-making frameworks that allow teams to move quickly while managing privacy and data protection risk effectively.

  • Foster a culture of responsible innovation, practical risk management, and accountable data use across the organization.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 15+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology law, regulatory advisory, or related legal and risk leadership roles, including significant in-house experience.

  • Extensive expertise in GDPR, European data protection expectations, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws.

  • Demonstrated ability to serve as a senior privacy leader or Data Protection Officer in a complex, global technology environment.

  • Experience advising Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and go-to-market teams on privacy by design, data protection risk, product launches, and customer-facing commitments.

  • Practical experience with PIAs, DPIAs, data mapping, transfer mechanisms, DPAs, SCCs, vendor risk, data subject rights, retention, and privacy incident response.

  • Strong understanding of privacy issues tied to emerging identity technology and use cases including biometrics, identity, AI, behavior analysis, automated processing, fraud prevention, and device intelligence.

  • Track record building or maturing privacy program operations in agile, high-growth, regulated, or enterprise SaaS environments.

  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to translate regulatory complexity into clear business decisions.

  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to build capability, set direction, and raise the operating maturity of a privacy function.

  • Law degree or equivalent legal/privacy qualification; membership in good standing with a relevant law society or bar is strongly preferred.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in RegTech, FinTech, identity verification, fraud prevention, payments, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.

  • Working knowledge of privacy and data protection frameworks in Asia-Pacific, India, China, and Latin America.

  • Experience supporting AI governance, responsible AI programs, model governance, or data ethics frameworks.

  • Familiarity with information security, data governance, cybersecurity, enterprise risk, or public-company readiness programs.

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPP/C, CIPM, CIPT, or equivalent credentials.

  • Experience speaking externally, publishing privacy insights, or representing a company in industry forums.

Interview Process:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes

  • Panel Interview: 60 minutes

  • Chief People Officer Interview: 45 minutes

  • Final Executive Interview: 30 minutes

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

Position Summary:

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to help build, maintain, and improve our cloud infrastructure and deployment systems on AWS. Reporting to the DevOps Manager, this role requires solid hands-on experience with infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability, along with growing ownership of services and systems.

You will work closely with engineering teams to ensure reliable deployments, scalable systems, and strong operational practices across ECS, EKS, and EC2-based workloads.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the San Diego office on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office).

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for reliable application deployments

  • Manage and improve AWS infrastructure across ECS, EKS, and EC2 environments

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform

  • Monitor system health and performance using Grafana and supporting observability tools

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues in staging and production environments

  • Collaborate with developers to improve deployment workflows and system reliability

  • Support containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS)

  • Implement and maintain logging, alerting, and incident response processes

  • Contribute to cost optimization and performance tuning within AWS

  • Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, processes, and runbooks

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Use AI-assisted tooling to draft, refactor, and review Terraform modules and Kubernetes/ECS manifests, improving delivery speed while maintaining quality and security standards

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or related roles

  • Hands-on experience with AWS services, particularly ECS, EKS, and EC2

  • Experience writing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform

  • Experience with monitoring/observability tools, especially Grafana

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)

  • Experience with containerization (Docker)

  • Working knowledge of Linux systems and networking fundamentals

  • Scripting experience (Bash, Python, or similar)

  • Can independently handle day-to-day infrastructure and deployment tasks

  • Comfortable debugging issues across application and infrastructure layers

  • Takes ownership of services (e.g., a cluster, pipeline, or environment)

  • Knows when to escalate complex architectural decisions

  • Proactively identifies reliability, performance, and cost improvements

  • Experience applying AI to DevOps practices, including infrastructure automation, CI/CD optimization, incident investigation, observability, and operational efficiency.

It’s A Bonus If You Have:

  • Experience operating Kubernetes clusters in production (EKS)

  • Familiarity with Prometheus or other metrics backends used with Grafana

  • Experience with AWS IAM, networking (VPCs, security groups), and load balancing

  • Exposure to autoscaling, high availability, and fault-tolerant system design

  • Experience with blue/green or canary deployments

  • Understanding of cost monitoring and optimization in AWS

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. What We Offer

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Position Summary:

We're hiring a Senior Business Development Manager to identify, sign, and launch new reselling partners for Trulioo. This is a hunter role: you own the full cycle of, sourcing, qualifying and building prospective partners, negotiating and closing partnership agreements, and driving each new partner through onboarding to their first revenue.

Where our Partner Success team grows and retains existing partners, you focus on net-new: finding the platforms and companies whose customers need identity verification, convincing them that Trulioo is the best solution to embed and resell, and getting them live and producing. Your remit will be global — while you're based in North America, you identify and pursue partner opportunities across multiple markets worldwide, following where industry trends and demand for identity verification are creating new opportunities. You carry a partner-acquisition target and are measured on the number and quality of partners you sign and successfully launch. Signing a partner is the beginning of the relationship. You partner closely with the Partner Success team staying engaged well beyond launch to jointly drive the partnership's early momentum and long-term success. You'll work across Business Development leadership, Partner Success, Legal, Product, Technical Account Management, and Marketing to move partners from first conversation to a thriving, growing relationship.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position working remotely out of North America, with a preference for USA-based applicants.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Identify opportunities across markets and industry trends. Track industry trends, regulatory shifts, and emerging demand for identity verification across global markets to identify where new partner opportunities are opening — and prioritize the markets and verticals with the strongest potential.

  • Build and own a global pipeline of prospective partners. Research markets worldwide and identify identity orchestration, risk decisioning, onboarding, and other platforms whose customers need identity verification and who are a strong fit to resell Trulioo.

  • Prospect and open new relationships. Run outbound outreach and leverage your network and industry presence to initiate conversations with target partners.

  • Qualify and prioritize partner fit. Evaluate prospective partners on commercial potential, technical fit, market reach, and strategic value; focus effort on the partnerships most likely to drive meaningful revenue.

  • Make the case for Trulioo. Deliver compelling pitches and product positioning to partner executives and commercial teams, articulating the value of embedding and reselling Trulioo's KYC, KYB, and AML solutions.

  • Negotiate and close partnership agreements. Lead commercial negotiations and work with Legal and compliance to structure, negotiate, and close reseller agreements.

  • Launch new partners to first revenue. Drive onboarding and go-to-market launch for each new partner — coordinating enablement, technical integration, and launch marketing — with a focus on speed to first deal.

  • Coordinate technical onboarding. Partner with Technical Account Management and Product to scope and stand up each new partner's integration so they can go live as quickly as possible.

  • Drive launch GTM with Marketing. Work with Marketing on partner launch and co-marketing activities that generate early pipeline for the new partnership.

  • Partner with Partner Success throughout the relationship. Work hand in hand with the Partner Success team from signing onward — jointly building the account plan, aligning on launch and growth strategy, and staying engaged beyond launch to help the partnership reach its full potential.

  • Maintain forecast and reporting discipline. Keep an accurate pipeline of prospective partners in our CRM; report regularly on sourcing, signings, launches, and attainment against your acquisition target.

  • Be the voice of the market internally. Feed partner and market intelligence back to Product, GTM, and BD leadership to sharpen partner strategy, targeting, and positioning.

  • Leverage AI-driven market insights. Use AI-assisted research to identify emerging partner ecosystems, regulatory trends, and whitespace opportunities that drive our global partner acquisition strategy.

  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working. Experiment with and continue to deploy best practices for using AI to improve business development workflows, account planning, content creation, and knowledge sharing across the team.

What You'll Bring:

  • 10+ years in channel/partner sales, business development, or alliances, ideally within fintech, SaaS, or identity/fraud/compliance solutions.

  • A demonstrated track record of sourcing, signing, and launching new partners — and of carrying and hitting partner-acquisition or partner-sourced revenue targets.

  • Experience identifying and developing partner or business opportunities across multiple international markets, and comfort reading industry trends to prioritize where to play.

  • Strong full-cycle sales skills: prospecting, qualification, executive-level pitching, and closing.

  • Experience negotiating and structuring commercial partnership or reseller agreements, and working with Legal to close them.

  • Comfort with technical, API-driven products and coordinating technical onboarding to get partners live.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM and partner management tools (e.g., Salesforce, PRM platforms).

  • Comfort operating independently in a remote, fast-moving environment, working across global time zones and markets from a North American base.

  • Extensive experience using AI-powered productivity and sales tools to improve research, prospecting, pipeline management, and customer engagement.

  • Experience incorporating AI into day-to-day workflows while maintaining critical thinking, sound judgment, and a customer-first approach.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience with identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB/AML, or regulatory compliance solutions.

  • Familiarity with identity orchestration, risk decisioning, or onboarding platforms and how they resell or embed third-party verification solutions.

  • An established network across fintech, banking, or digital commerce that can be activated to source partners.

  • Experience standing up or scaling a partner/channel program from early stages.

  • A track record of collaborating closely with post-sales or account management teams to grow partnerships over time.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Why Join Us:

At Trulioo, our partners help extend digital trust to more people and businesses around the world — and this role builds that network from the ground up. You'll scan global markets for the platforms that will carry Trulioo into new regions and verticals, close the partnerships that expand our reach, and stay with them as they grow.

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

Position Summary:

We're hiring a Senior Partner Success Manager to own every aspect of account management for the partners who resell Trulioo's identity verification solutions. You will be the primary account manager and trusted advisor for a portfolio of reseller partners in North America, accountable for the full lifecycle of those relationships — pipeline, enablement, co-selling, expansion, technical alignment, and growth.

This is a success-led, relationship-driven role focused on deepening and growing the partnerships we already have rather than recruiting net-new partners. Your core mandate is growth: you will carry a small year-over-year net-new revenue target across your portfolio. You'll succeed by making partners exceptional at selling Trulioo, building and reviewing pipeline, upselling their existing clients into new products, and keeping the technical relationship healthy. You'll sit at the center of a cross-functional effort — coordinating Technical Account Management, Product, Marketing, and Support — to ensure every partner in your portfolio is set up to win.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position working remotely out of North America, with a preference for U.S.-based applicants.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own the partner relationship end to end. Serve as the dedicated account manager and single point of contact for a portfolio of active reseller partners, responsible for all aspects of account management across their commercial, technical, and executive teams.

  • Own a net-new growth target. Carry a year-over-year revenue growth number across your portfolio; drive each partner to grow their Trulioo revenue over the prior year and be accountable for hitting that expansion target.

  • Build and review pipeline. Partner with each reseller to build, review, and progress their Trulioo pipeline; run regular pipeline reviews to inspect deals, remove blockers, and hold forecast accountability.

  • Train partner sales teams. Deliver onboarding and ongoing sales enablement so partner reps can confidently position, pitch, and sell Trulioo's KYC, KYB, and AML solutions to their customers.

  • Co-sell alongside partners. Join partner reps in front of their prospects and customers to help position Trulioo, advance opportunities, and close deals.

  • Upsell into the existing base. Identify and drive opportunities to upsell partners' existing clients onto net-new Trulioo products and capabilities.

  • Run QBRs and business reviews. Lead recurring and executive business reviews that reinforce value, review performance against plan, surface opportunities, and strengthen the relationship.

  • Partner with Technical Account Management. Work closely with the TAM team to keep each partner's API integration current, healthy, and aligned to the latest Trulioo capabilities, and to resolve technical friction quickly.

  • Identify new opportunities within each partner. Continuously map each partner's business to uncover new use cases, product fits, and expansion paths for Trulioo.

  • Be the voice of the partner internally. Represent partner needs and market feedback to Product, Marketing, and GTM teams to shape roadmap, packaging, and enablement.

  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working. Experiment with and continue to deploy best practices for using AI to improve partner success workflows, account planning, content creation, and knowledge sharing across the team.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years in partner success, channel account management, strategic account management, or partner/channel sales, ideally within fintech, SaaS, or identity/fraud/compliance solutions.

  • A demonstrated track record of growing a portfolio of partners or accounts and hitting revenue growth or expansion targets.

  • Hands-on experience with the full account management motion: pipeline building and review, co-selling, sales enablement/training, QBRs, and upselling into an existing base.

  • Experience managing relationships with technical, API-driven products, and comfort partnering with technical teams and translating between commercial and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong consultative relationship-building skills, with the ability to earn trust at both the practitioner and executive level.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM and partner/customer management tools (e.g., Salesforce, PRM platforms).

  • Comfort operating independently in a remote, fast-moving environment across North American time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience with identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB/AML, or regulatory compliance solutions.

  • Familiarity with identity orchestration, risk decisioning, or onboarding platforms and how they resell or embed third-party verification solutions.

  • Experience owning both retention and expansion targets within a partner or channel motion.

  • An established network across fintech, banking, or digital commerce.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

At Trulioo, our partners help extend digital trust to more people and businesses around the world — and this role sits at the heart of that mission. You'll own relationships with some of the most innovative platforms in fintech, work cross-functionally with teams that care about getting partners to success, and have real ownership over a growing portfolio.

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary:

The Chief of Staff at Trulioo is a critical leadership role that drives strategic alignment, operational execution, and organizational effectiveness at the highest levels of the company. Acting as a trusted advisor and right-hand to the CEO, you will ensure that executive priorities are translated into action, internal processes are optimized, and cross-functional collaboration is seamless.

You will work closely with the CEO and the executive team, serving as a thought partner, problem-solver, and operational lead across a wide array of strategic initiatives. This role requires exceptional judgment, discretion, communication, and project management capabilities. The ideal candidate brings a blend of strategic thinking, execution excellence, and operational rigor, paired with the humility and flexibility to operate both behind the scenes and in leadership settings.

A defining part of this role is AI fluency: you will be the executive team’s go-to person for identifying where AI tools can remove friction, accelerate decisions, and free up leadership time and you’ll model that adoption yourself before asking others to follow.

This is a full-time position available on either a permanent or fixed-term basis, with a preference for a permanent hire. Remote work may be considered for the right candidate

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Set and sustain the operating rhythm. Own executive meetings, business reviews, board meetings, and offsites, including agendas, pre-reads, decisions, and follow-through. Ensure everyone leaves clear on what was decided and who owns it.

  • Run the goal-setting system. Own the OKR process end-to-end, and give the CEO and leadership team an honest read on where the business actually stands.

  • Prepare the CEO for high-stakes moments. Build board materials, executive presentations, and briefings for critical internal and external meetings.

  • Lead what nobody owns. Find the gaps, lead the cross-functional initiatives that fill them, then hand them off cleanly. Expect two or three running at a time, including initiatives to identify, pilot, and roll out AI tools that streamline internal processes across teams.

  • Extend the CEO's reach. Shape communications for town halls, company updates, and speaking engagements. Stand in for the CEO where appropriate, knowing what to decide and what to bring back.

  • Be a candid thought partner. Help the CEO prioritize and pressure-test decisions.

  • Champion AI adoption across the executive team. Act as the internal evangelist and coach for practical AI use, identifying high-value use cases, vetting new tools, running lightweight trainings, and helping executives build AI-augmented habits into their own workflows.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in executive operations, management consulting, corporate strategy, project management, or business operations, preferably within a fast-paced tech or SaaS environment.

  • Proven experience supporting C-level executives or founders in a Chief of Staff, Business Manager, or Strategic Advisor role.

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to connect the dots and drive clarity across complexity.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft high-impact executive communications.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously under tight deadlines.

  • High EQ and interpersonal intelligence - able to influence, mediate, and build trust across all levels of the organization.

  • Absolute discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive and confidential information.

Interview Process:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30-minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45-minutes

  • Follow-Up Interview: 45-Minutes

  • Leadership Interview: 45-minutes

  • Final Interview: 60-minutes

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary:

Trulioo is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the architecture and development of high-throughput, low-latency back-end services that power our Document and Biometric Verification platform. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering, the Senior Software Engineer will design and operate distributed, event-driven microservices that orchestrate real-time identity verification - ingesting captured documents and biometric data, coordinating ML inference and third-party vendor calls, and returning verification decisions at scale across multiple global regions. You will bridge the gap between developer-facing APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, and the ML and infrastructure systems that sit behind them.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position, ideally working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office). However, we are open to remote arrangements for the right candidate.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Service Architecture: Design, build, and maintain secure, modular, horizontally-scalable microservices

  • API & Contract Design: Own the gRPC/Protobuf contracts that drive inter-service communication, and the REST/OpenAPI surfaces exposed to external clients, with versioning and backward-compatibility discipline.

  • Event-Driven Pipelines: Build robust, high-throughput streaming pipelines on Apache Kafka - designing topics, consumers, and stream-processing topologies to process transaction lifecycle events and coordinate downstream verification steps.

  • Data & State Management: Model and optimize data access across distributed NoSQL databases, search/indexing systems, and caching layers; design for consistency, idempotency, and retention/compliance requirements.

  • Workflow Orchestration: Implement durable, multi-step verification workflows using a workflow engine to guarantee reliable execution across service and vendor boundaries.

  • Performance & Reliability: Drive sub-second end-to-end verification latency and predictable throughput; tune coroutine concurrency, backpressure, and event-driven autoscaling across a wide range of load profiles.

  • Technical Leadership: Drive technical architecture, mentor engineers, and collaborate with Machine Learning, Infrastructure, and Product teams to deploy computer vision models and vendor integrations into production.

  • Leveraging AI:

    • AI-Augmented Engineering: Use AI coding assistants and internal tooling to accelerate service design, implementation, testing, and code review across the microservices platform.

    • Intelligent Pipeline Optimization: Apply AI/ML-driven analysis (anomaly detection, log and metrics insight, capacity forecasting) to continuously tune verification-pipeline performance, throughput, and decision logic.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 8+ years back-end/server software engineering experience delivering production-grade, distributed services or platforms.

  • JVM & Kotlin: Deep proficiency with Kotlin (or strong Java transitioning to Kotlin) and modern JVM concurrency, including Kotlin Coroutines and structured concurrency.

  • Microservices & APIs: Hands-on experience building service-oriented or microservice architectures with gRPC/Protobuf and/or REST, including API design, versioning, and inter-service communication patterns.

  • Distributed Systems & Messaging: Demonstrated experience with event streaming and asynchronous messaging (Apache Kafka strongly preferred), including consumer scaling, exactly-once/idempotent processing, and failure handling.

  • Data Stores: Practical experience with distributed NoSQL databases, search/indexing systems, and caching strategies at scale.

  • Cloud Native: Comfortable operating services in a public cloud environment on Kubernetes, with familiarity around containerization, service meshes, and infrastructure-as-code.

  • Resource Optimization: Demonstrated expertise managing memory, thread/coroutine concurrency, connection pooling, and payload optimization for high-throughput, latency-sensitive workloads.

  • AI Expectations:

    • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on daily use of AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate design, implementation, testing, and code review.

    • Critical Evaluation: Ability to critically assess AI-generated code and outputs for correctness, security, and performance before it reaches production.

    • Applied AI/ML Literacy: Working understanding of how LLMs and ML models behave in production (latency, cost, failure modes) sufficient to reason about AI-driven components in a backend system.

It’s a bonus if you have…

  • Identity Verification: Experience with IDV (Identity Verification), KYC systems, or integrating with biometric liveness/anti-spoofing and document-authenticity engines.

  • Workflow & Orchestration: Familiarity with durable workflow engines (Temporal, Cadence, or equivalent) for coordinating long-running, multi-service processes.

  • ML Integration: Experience serving or integrating ML models into back-end services (e.g., Deep Java Library, PyTorch, ONNX, or TensorFlow) and orchestrating third-party vendor APIs.

  • Observability & Ops: Experience with modern observability tooling (metrics, logs, and distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry) and running multi-region production services.

  • DevOps/CI: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerized builds, Helm-based Kubernetes deployments, and secrets management.

Interview Process:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30-minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45-minutes

  • Panel Interview: 60-minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 30-minutes

 

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

You will build relationships with key stakeholders, uncover business needs, and position Trulioo’s solutions across customer onboarding, identity verification, continuous monitoring, risk management, and fraud prevention.

  • Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, inbound lead conversion, and strategic customer engagement.

  • Generate at least $250,000 in new pipeline each quarter through self-sourced opportunities and the progression of qualified inbound leads.

  • Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle with discipline and professionalism, balancing near-term conversion with longer-term growth opportunities.

  • Maintain a rolling pipeline of at least four times your quota to support consistent performance.

  • Lead engaging product demonstrations tailored to the needs and use cases of qualified prospects.

  • Maintain accurate and timely Salesforce records to support reliable forecasting and pipeline visibility.

  • Drive an efficient sales process, targeting an average sales cycle of 90 days or less.

  • Leverage AI to increase capacity, improve productivity, and enhance sales effectiveness.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of B2B experience in a software Account Executive role focused on new business acquisition.

  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota

  • Proven success building, progressing, and closing pipeline through proactive prospecting and a disciplined sales process; experience with MEDDPICC is an asset.

  • Experience managing deal sizes ranging from $20,000 to $100,000+ and a portfolio of 20+ active opportunities at a time.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical product specifications and value propositions.

  • Strong business and technical aptitude, with a demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly.

  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills, along with the ability to use AI confidently and responsibly.

  • A self-motivated, detail-oriented approach and a strong drive to achieve ambitious goals.

  • Relevant industry experience in identity, fraud, compliance, or financial services is an asset.

  • Familiarity with sales tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Clay, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ChatGPT, and Claude.

Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Manager of Solutions Consulting EMEA, this role sits at the intersection of technology, revenue, and customer success. You’ll partner with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Service Delivery to solve complex identity challenges for enterprise customers, leading efforts from the discovery and solution design through to evaluation for prospects and existing customers.

You’ll translate technical and business requirements into scalable solutions, lead technical engagements, and ensure customers realize maximum value from Trulioo’s platform. This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who enjoys deep technical problem-solving while influencing strategic outcomes.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position that can be done remotely for the right person.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Engage with customers directly, acting as the key technical point of contact for our most strategic customers

  • Own the discovery process to uncover business objectives, customer technical requirements, run technical demonstrations and proof of concepts

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver seamless customer outcomes

  • Contribute to internal knowledge and technical excellence

What You’ll Bring:

Key Skills

  • Proven ability to simplify complex concepts, deliver effective product demonstrations, and communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels

  • Advise on best practices across identity, compliance, fraud, risk and integrations, adapting your approach to different customer contexts and levels of technical depth

  • Strong API expertise (REST, API design, OAuth, API keys, JSON/XML) with the ability to translate complexity into clear, actionable solutions

  • Comfortable working independently and cross-functionally, collaborating with distributed teams across regions

  • Apply a “Trusted Expert” mindset to interpret customer requirements and recommend flexible, forward-thinking solutions

  • Written and verbal English proficiency is required

  • Familiarity with LLMs and AI tools is a bonus

Education and Experience:

  • Post-Secondary Degree or combination of desired experience and education

  • 3-5 years experience in a Senior Technical Support, Solutions Consultant or Implementation Specialist role. Relative experience or in identity verification, compliance, or fintech industries is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

  • Technical background with familiarity in JSON, RESTful APIs, and native and web-based SDKs would be desirable.

Interview Process:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes

  • Panel Interview: 60 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 30 minutes

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, the Staff Engineer or Architect (Agentic AI Team) will be responsible for designing, building, and owning agent systems end-to-end - from design through production. This role involves building reliable, steerable, multi-step agent workflows that plan, execute, observe outcomes, and iteratively improve.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position, either working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office) or remotely within North America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design, build, and own agent systems end-to-end - from design through production - for identity, fraud, risk, and commerce workflows. You own the eval harness and observability for what you ship, not just the happy path.

  • Build reliable, steerable, multi-step agent workflows that plan, execute, observe outcomes, and iteratively improve - including tool use and human-in-the-loop patterns appropriate to regulated, high-stakes decisions.

  • Troubleshoot novel, non-deterministic failures across models, tools, orchestration, and infrastructure. You stay calm under ambiguity, form hypotheses, instrument the system, and find the root cause.

  • Work in a compliance-heavy, globally regulated domain where auditability, correctness, and human oversight are features, not afterthoughts.

  • Set and communicate a technical vision - to teammates and to the agents you direct. You make the implicit explicit: a spec an agent can execute is a spec a teammate can trust.

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Orchestrate AI agents in your daily work and hold the bar on what they produce. You keep a clear mental model of the system, verify what changed, and stay accountable - AI is a force multiplier, not an excuse.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated impact on production systems.

  • Fluency using AI agents in your own engineering workflow - you can show us how you keep a mental model, verify outputs, and stay accountable while moving faster with AI.

  • Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience working on challenging, novel, or ambiguous projects where you had to define the problem, not just solve a handed-down spec.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs - prompt engineering, RAG, tool use, and at least one agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar), plus evaluation frameworks for agent behavior.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in financial services, identity, fraud, or risk domains, or other compliance-heavy environments (AML, fraud rules engines, identity graphs, risk scoring).

  • Multi-agent orchestration patterns and production-grade evaluation harnesses.

  • AI observability tooling; MLOps practices (experiment tracking, model registries, feature stores).

  • Vector databases, knowledge graphs, or structured retrieval for agent memory.

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Sales Director, the Mid-Market Account Executive will own the full sales cycle for new business across the Payments, e-Commerce, Financial Services, and Technology sectors. You will build relationships with key stakeholders, uncover business needs, and position Trulioo’s solutions across customer onboarding, identity verification, continuous monitoring, risk management, and fraud prevention.

This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong technical aptitude, and the ability to connect customer challenges with Trulioo’s capabilities and measurable business outcomes. You will thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to building pipeline and converting qualified opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office).


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, inbound lead conversion, and strategic customer engagement.

  • Generate at least $400,000 in new pipeline each quarter through self-sourced opportunities and the progression of qualified inbound leads.

  • Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle with discipline and professionalism, balancing near-term conversion with longer-term growth opportunities.

  • Maintain a rolling pipeline of at least four times your quota to support consistent performance.

  • Lead engaging product demonstrations tailored to the needs and use cases of qualified prospects.

  • Maintain accurate and timely Salesforce records to support reliable forecasting and pipeline visibility.

  • Drive an efficient sales process, targeting an average sales cycle of 90 days or less.

  • Leverage AI to increase capacity, improve productivity, and enhance sales effectiveness.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of B2B experience in a software Account Executive role focused on new business acquisition.

  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota

  • Proven success building, progressing, and closing pipeline through proactive prospecting and a disciplined sales process; experience with MEDDPICC is an asset.

  • Experience managing deal sizes ranging from $20,000 to $100,000+ and a portfolio of 20+ active opportunities at a time.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical product specifications and value propositions.

  • Strong business and technical aptitude, with a demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly.

  • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills, along with the ability to use AI confidently and responsibly.

  • A self-motivated, detail-oriented approach and a strong drive to achieve ambitious goals.

  • Relevant industry experience in identity, fraud, compliance, or financial services is an asset.

  • Familiarity with sales tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Clay, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ChatGPT, and Claude.

Interview Process

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45-60 minutes

  • Panel/Assignment/Presentation: 60 minutes

The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000–$110,000 CAD, with an on-target earnings (OTE) range of approximately $150,000–$183,333 CAD.

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the VP, Sales (North America), the Director, Enterprise Sales is responsible for building and leading our Enterprise Account Executive team across North America. This leader will own the full revenue motion, from new-logo acquisition through expansion and growth within existing enterprise accounts, covering pipeline generation, deal management, forecasting, and close, while hiring, coaching, and scaling a high-performing AE team.

The ideal candidate has extensive B2B sales and sales management experience, ideally in a high-growth startup environment, selling complex products into large enterprises and growing those relationships over time. We strongly prefer candidates from a similar or adjacent industry - specifically identity verification, fraud, or risk management - with deep familiarity with Fintech, Payments, Banking, Marketplaces, Gig Economy, AI/Technology, and/or Gaming verticals.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position, which can be done remotely within the USA for the right candidate.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Team Leadership & Management

  • Hire, develop, motivate, and mentor a team of Enterprise Account Executives, ramping new hires quickly to meet productivity goals across both new-logo and expansion targets

  • Set clear goals and foster a culture of accountability, coaching, and high performance

  • Coach AEs on deal strategy, opening and qualifying opportunities, account planning, and consultative/complex-deal selling techniques, including multi-threading and expanding within existing customers

  • Build an inclusive, diverse team culture where AEs feel supported to take risks, learn from losses, and grow

Pipeline, Deal Management & Forecasting

  • Own pipeline for both new-logo and expansion opportunities: coverage, velocity, and conversion across the team

  • Drive rigorous deal management — actively engaging in strategy for key opportunities, unblocking stalled deals, and reviewing deal health regularly

  • Drive expansion revenue through upsell, cross-sell, and new use cases within existing enterprise accounts, partnering with AEs to build account plans and identify whitespace

  • Own accurate weekly/monthly/quarterly forecasting and reporting on new business and expansion revenue to the VP, Sales and leadership team

  • Support sales conversion by directly engaging with prospects and existing customers on strategic or complex deals

  • Champion the use of AI-powered sales tools (e.g., forecasting, deal intelligence, conversation intelligence, prospecting/enablement platforms) to improve pipeline accuracy, rep productivity, and deal execution

Strategy & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build a strategic plan for the NA Enterprise segment covering new-logo acquisition and expansion, with clear KPIs, targets, and timelines

  • Develop productive cross-functional partnerships with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to support pipeline generation, deal execution, and account growth. Work closely with Customer Success on renewals, expansion plays, and customer health

  • Think creatively to devise winning sales strategies and go-to-market plays for target verticals, including land-and-expand motions

  • Help shape how AI is positioned within the sales narrative, including articulating the value of AI-driven identity, fraud, and risk solutions to prospects and existing customers


What You’ll Bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B sales management, with a track record of hiring, ramping, and scaling high-growth Enterprise sales teams that win new logos and grow existing accounts

  • Experience driving expansion and net revenue retention in enterprise accounts, including account planning, upsell and cross-sell, and executive-level relationship building within existing customers

  • Experience closing and expanding large, complex Enterprise deals, with a demonstrated ability to sell a complex product

  • Strong command of pipeline management, deal management, and forecasting disciplines, across both new business and expansion revenue

  • Proven ability to influence, develop, and empower team members to achieve objectives, and to build inclusive, diverse teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels, including the C-suite

  • Comfortable operating in an AI-forward sales environment: leveraging AI tools for forecasting, pipeline management, and productivity, and confidently articulating the value of AI-powered products to enterprise buyers and existing customers

  • Prior exposure to Fintech, Payments, Banking, Marketplaces, Gig Economy, AI/Technology, and/or Gaming verticals strongly preferred; GRC or KYC/AML software experience a plus

Interview Process:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes

  • Panel/Presentation/Assignment: 60 minutes

  • Chief People Officer Interview: 60 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 45 minutes

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.
