Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering, the Manager, Engineering will be responsible for leading Trulioo's mobile and web engineering team. This role owns team execution, technical direction, delivery quality, and cross-functional alignment for mobile and web products spanning iOS, Android, and Web, including consumer-focused flows that bring together Device Intelligence, KYC Docs, KYC Data, EID, and future identity capabilities. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Sales, Solutions, Platform, and senior technical leadership to turn business priorities into reliable, customer-ready mobile and web experiences.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver or San Diego office on a hybrid model (3 days per week in the office).

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Lead and coach a team of engineers across iOS, Android, and Web, building an accountable, collaborative team culture that performs under deadline pressure.

  • Own mobile and web delivery end to end – from discovery through release – including planning, sequencing, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.

  • Set technical direction for mobile and web architecture, integration patterns, and quality standards, and hold the team to a high delivery bar.

  • Partner with Product and UX to shape customer-focused mobile and web experiences that are practical to build and aligned to Trulioo's product strategy.

  • Coordinate across backend, platform, identity, data, and go-to-market teams to keep mobile and web work aligned with business priorities and customer commitments.

  • Establish and maintain engineering practices for code quality, automated testing, release readiness, observability, accessibility, and performance.

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Introduce and scale a shared AI-assisted workflow across the team – for code review, testing, or documentation – and hold a clear bar for catching and correcting weak AI output before it ships.

What You'll Bring:

  • BSc degree in computer science, engineering, or another STEM field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including native mobile, web development, or adjacent product delivery.

  • 2+ years of experience in a technical leadership, team leadership, or engineering management capacity.

  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to coach engineers, unblock delivery, and give clear, actionable feedback.

  • Strong technical judgment, with the ability to make architecture and implementation tradeoffs under real delivery constraints.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to connect technical work to customer value and business impact.

  • Experience with the following tools/technology: Swift, Kotlin, React, TypeScript, React Native, and Kotlin Multiplatform.

  • Demonstrated experience introducing or scaling a shared AI-assisted workflow, template, or tool within a team, with a clear process for catching and correcting weak AI output.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience integrating mobile and web apps with identity, verification, fintech, risk, or compliance-oriented platforms.

  • Experience with App Store / Play Store release processes, feature flags, analytics, crash reporting, and product observability.

  • Experience with cloud-backed mobile and web applications, microservices, APIs, and secure data handling.

Interview Process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45-60 minutes

  • Panel/Assignment/Presentation: 60 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 30-45 minutes

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering, the Intermediate Software Engineer will be responsible for building and hardening Trulioo's Agentic AI Verification capabilities, taking agent-based verification workflows from proof-of-concept to production-grade systems. This role involves designing test cases and evaluation checks for agent behavior, contributing to the data pipelines that feed the agents, and partnering with Product and senior engineers to turn business requirements into shipped features.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This is a full-time, permanent position based out of our San Diego or Vancouver office, working on a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office).

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build and ship agent capabilities (e.g., Vertex AI-based Discovery Agents) from design through production, owning your slice of the SDLC, implementation, testing, and deployment.

  • Harden proof-of-concept agent code into production-grade quality, strengthening error handling, observability, and testing, with an eye on cost and latency.

  • Design test cases and evaluation checks for non-deterministic agent behavior, a distinct skill from testing traditional deterministic code.

  • Build and maintain data ingestion and pipeline work that feeds the agent, using AWS and big-data tooling.

  • Partner with Product and senior engineers to translate business requirements into shipped features.

  • Contribute to production support: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for an AI-driven service.

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as a routine part of your development workflow, with a clear habit of reviewing and verifying generated output before it ships.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.

  • 2-4 years of experience in a software engineering or development role.

  • A self-starter mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out rather than waiting for a fully specified task.

  • A strong collaborator who communicates clearly and works well alongside more senior engineers.

  • Solid foundation in Python and/or another backend language, with the ability to write clean, readable, testable code.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and experience with basic API design (REST at minimum).

  • Experience with the following tools/technology: AWS, and exposure to data pipeline tools such as PySpark or Airflow.

  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants as a routine part of your workflow, and have built at least one project involving an LLM doing more than single-shot Q&A – calling tools/functions, chaining steps, or coordinating multiple steps toward a goal.

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to orchestration or big-data tools (Apache Airflow, Dagster, Spark, Presto/Trino, Hive).

  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, AWS CDK).

  • Interest or coursework in identity verification, fraud, security, or fintech.

Interview Process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 60 minutes

  • Panel Interview: 60 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 30-45 minutes

Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Workplace Experience Lead, the Workplace Experience Coordinator will be responsible for the day-to-day operation of our Vancouver office and for the experience people have while they are in it. The role spans front-of-house reception, facilities and supplies, shipping, and health and safety, alongside the events, team lunches, and swag that bring the office together. It will suit someone who takes pride in a well-run workplace and enjoys creating the moments that bring a team together.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office, on-site five days per week.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own the front-of-house experience — welcome visitors, candidates, and vendors, answer and route incoming calls, correspondence, and the shared office inbox within agreed response times, and keep the office secure by maintaining the visitor log and issuing badges.

  • Keep the office running day to day through regular walkthroughs, meeting room checks, upkeep across multiple kitchens, and daily supply ordering and inventory, receipt reconciliation, liaising with building maintenance and janitorial staff to resolve issues quickly.

  • Coordinate vendors and manage swag orders for employee onboarding and one- and five-year anniversaries, including custom LEGO swag and Trulioo Values bricks. Manage the shipment of equipment, swag, and other items through FedEx, DHL, and other courier services.

  • Curate the in-office experience alongside the Workplace Experience Lead — monthly events spanning ERG, wellness, cultural, social, and DE&I programming, twice-weekly team lunches, from researching restaurants across the city to placing the order, and a monthly happy hour.

  • Chair the Health and Safety Committee, running the monthly meeting and keeping the office's safety practices, training, and documentation current.

  • Keep recurring office administration on schedule — onboarding and offboarding tracking, monthly budget and invoice reporting for office purchases, anniversary date reports, and the monthly reporting that supports our internal compliance requirements.

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Use AI assistants to triage and summarize the shared office inbox, draft event and office communications, and pull together recurring monthly reports from existing data.

What You'll Bring:

  • Education: Bachelors of Business Administration or equivalent experience. CPR-C and AED certification, or willingness to become certified through Trulioo.

  • Experience: 2–4 years in Hospitality or Facilities field, office coordination, reception, or administrative support.

  • Soft skills: Warm, professional communication with everyone from candidates to executives; a calm, organized approach to competing priorities; and the flexibility to change direction when the day does.

  • Hard skills: Inventory and supply management, vendor coordination, invoice and budget tracking, courier and shipping logistics, event planning, and recurring monthly reporting. Able to be on your feet for long periods and lift 50lbs.

  • Technology: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Slack, Zoom, Navan and courier portals such as FedEx and DHL.

Nice to Have:

  • AI fluency: Comfort using AI assistants such as Claude or Gemini to draft, summarize, and organize daily work, with the judgment to review output before it goes out and to handle confidential information appropriately.

  • Facilities or building operations experience: coordinating with property management on maintenance, repairs, and building access, and holding on-site vendors to their service standards.

  • A hospitality, concierge, or events background, and the service standard that comes with it.

  • Working knowledge of Vancouver's restaurant and venue scene for lunches, socials, and offsites.

Interview Process:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes

  • Panel Interview: 60 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 30 minutes

 

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director of IT, the IT Lead will be responsible for owning our global network and providing technical direction to a growing IT team. This is a hands-on individual contributor role responsible for our network and VPN modernization, advising our senior systems administrators on which technical path to take, and mentoring the team on the technical side. You will also drive our SSO rollout and the integration of AI into business-critical systems.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This is a full-time, permanent position based out of our Vancouver office, working on a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office).

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own the network across our Vancouver, San Diego, and Dublin offices on our Cisco Meraki stack, and lead the evaluation and modernization of our remote access and network access architecture.

  • Provide technical guidance to the IT team, advising senior systems administrators on network, architecture, and tooling decisions and supporting team members with technical questions and troubleshooting across networking, endpoint management, identity, and asset tracking.

  • Drive the SSO integration roadmap across remaining applications, partnering with the platform owner to prioritize, sequence, and close out incomplete integrations.

  • Improve the operational maturity of the IT service function:

    • Own queue health, SLAs and escalation paths

    • Establish monthly trend reporting, practical runbooks and lightweight change management

    • Automate provisioning and deprovisioning tied to HR system events.

    • Grow into ownership of the software lifecycle, including vendor renewals, onboarding requests, and cost reviews, with in-house training and support.

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Lead hands-on integration of AI capabilities into business critical IT systems and workflows, using AI-assisted approaches to draft configurations, automation and runbooks while independently validating outputs against security policy and actual system behaviour.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5–8 years of experience in IT operations, systems, or network administration, including at least 2 years in a senior technical role advising team members on technical decisions and troubleshooting complex issues.

  • Clear, direct written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to senior engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems without an existing playbook.

  • Coaching skills and the patience to build technical ownership in newer team members.

  • Deep hands-on experience administering multi-site enterprise networks, including evaluating and rolling out modern VPN and zero-trust network access solutions such as mesh-based architectures.

  • Strong technical background across networking, identity, and endpoint management, with the judgment to evaluate options and recommend a technical direction to senior administrators.

  • Working knowledge of SSO and identity concepts (SAML, OIDC), plus experience building or improving change-management and documentation practices from a low baseline.

  • Some experience with software procurement or vendor management, with in-house training to build the rest.

  • Experience with the following tools/technology: Cisco Meraki networking, mesh VPN or zero-trust network access platforms, SSO and identity platforms (SAML, OIDC), endpoint management (Intune, Jamf, or equivalent), and ITSM tooling (Jira Service Management or similar).

  • AI fluency: you build AI-assisted workflows into your own work, direct AI tools on real tasks, and verify their output with sound judgment before relying on it.

Nice to Have:

  • Cloud fundamentals across AWS, Azure, or GCP, as our cloud footprint and the expertise we need in this area will grow from 2027 onward.

  • ITIL Foundation or equivalent process certification.

  • Hands-on experience with AI governance, such as acceptable-use policy and cost monitoring.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, the Senior Demand Generation Manager is responsible for owning net new pipeline for mid-market and enterprise accounts, with a real account-based motion built in from the start. You run webinar, email, paid, website, and event channels as one connected engine, and you're measured on the pipeline that comes out of it, not the campaigns you ship. You partner closely with product marketing and content, manage our external paid digital acquisition agency, own the events team, and build a tight daily working relationship with sales development, which sits in the revenue organization.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This is a full-time, permanent position based out of our Vancouver or San Diego office on a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office). Candidates outside these locations may be considered for a fully remote arrangement within North America.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own integrated demand generation and account-based marketing strategy and execution across webinar, email, paid, website, and event channels, for net new mid-market and enterprise acquisition.

  • Co-own the acquisition funnel target with sales, tracking it daily and partnering with sales development leadership to convert demand into qualified pipeline.

  • Build and maintain attribution and lead scoring in partnership with marketing operations, reporting weekly and monthly on acquisition pipeline performance, and make program and channel decisions, including cutting what isn't earning its spend.

  • Lead the events team, with a mandate to make it a pipeline-accountable function across net new and, with Lifecycle, expansion-focused events.

  • Manage the external paid digital acquisition agency relationship and its performance, and own messaging, assets, and ideal customer profile definition in partnership with product marketing and content.

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Build and direct AI-enabled workflows across campaigns, targeting, and personalization, reviewing outputs against pipeline results before scaling them.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation or growth marketing, selling specifically into mid-market and enterprise accounts. Self-serve or small business motion alone won't translate here.

  • Strong cross-functional operating skill with sales, product marketing, content, and marketing operations.

  • Comfort operating in both enterprise buying committees and faster-moving mid-market cycles, with a clear point of view on running each differently.

  • A track record of building a demand generation and account-based marketing strategy from the ground up, including account selection, segmentation, and investment prioritization, not just executing against an existing playbook.

  • Experience co-owning a pipeline or revenue number with sales, including the strategic tradeoffs that come with it.

  • Hands-on fluency building and defending attribution and lead-scoring models.

  • Experience managing an agency relationship with real performance accountability.

  • Experience with the following tools/technology: Marketo and Salesforce, at a working-knowledge level.

  • A demonstrated use of AI that drove a growth outcome, such as a workflow, test, or targeting model you built or directed and that others on your team adopt, with results to show.

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech, identity, compliance, or another regulated B2B category.

  • Direct experience with an account-based marketing platform such as Demandbase, 6sense, or a comparable tool.

  • Experience with go-to-market engineering tools like Clay, or building no-code automations that connect CRM, enrichment, and outbound systems.

Interview Process

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45–60 minutes

  • Panel/Assignment/Presentation: 60 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 30–45 minutes

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

  • Real experience running account-based campaigns that reached multiple members of a buying committee, not a single champion.

  • Demonstrated use of AI to drive an adoption or expansion outcome, a workflow, a signal model, or a campaign you built or directed, with results to show.

Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

  • Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

  • Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

  • Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

The Talent Acquisition Coordinator will be responsible for keeping our hiring process running smoothly, from scheduling and candidate communication to sourcing support, recruitment events, and co-op hiring cycles. This role involves working closely with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interview panels to ensure every step of the hiring journey is well-coordinated and on track.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This is a full-time, permanent position based out of our Vancouver office, working on a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office).

What You'll Be Doing

  • Coordinate interview scheduling and serve as a key point of contact for candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels, delivering a smooth and timely candidate experience

  • Lead the co-op hiring program, running 3 hiring cohorts per year and campus events

  • Support recruiters by sourcing and engaging candidates for open roles, including high-volume hiring cycles, using LinkedIn Recruiter and other channels

  • Prepare job postings, create jobs in our applicant tracking system (Ashby), and keep candidate records and statuses accurate

  • Support offer letter preparation, new hire onboarding logistics, and basic recruiting metrics reporting

  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement while ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant use of AI tools.

  • Use AI tools through a repeatable workflow to draft candidate communications and sourcing outreach, support scheduling coordination, and summarize interview feedback notes, reviewing every output for accuracy and confidentiality before it is sent or recorded

What You'll Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is an asset

  • 2–5 years of experience in a coordination, administrative, or customer-facing role

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines without dropping details

  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers

  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach, with comfort asking questions and flagging opportunities for improvement

  • Experience with the following tools/technology: applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, scheduling tools, and standard office/productivity software

  • Experience using AI tools as a routine part of your own work through a repeatable process, with a habit of checking the output for accuracy before relying on it

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

  • Exposure to resume screening

  • Experience with an applicant tracking system such as Ashby or Greenhouse

Interview Process

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

  • Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview: 45–60 minutes

  • Panel/Presentation: 60 minutes

  • Final Leadership Interview: 30–45 minutes

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.

We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification.

Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.

Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.
